name: url
label: URL
help: The page to check, for example `https://example.com`. `https://` is added when no scheme is given.

name: webhook_url
label: Webhook URL
help: Optional. Receives the score-change event as JSON. Slack incoming-webhook URLs get a formatted message.

name: alert_threshold
label: Alert Threshold (points)
help: How many points the score must move before an alert. Default 5.
